description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the AWS Route53 Recovery Cluster service, including methods for managing routing controls and their states.

classes.name: Route53RecoveryClusterClient
classes.description: A client class for managing interactions with AWS Route53 Recovery Cluster service, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: getRoutingControlState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a routing control.

methods.name: getRoutingControlStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current state of a routing control.

methods.name: listRoutingControls
methods.description: Lists all routing controls associated with the service.

methods.name: updateRoutingControlState
methods.description: Updates the state of a specified routing control.

methods.name: updateRoutingControlStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the state of a routing control.

methods.name: updateRoutingControlStatesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates multiple routing control states.
